mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ddh_configuration_management WHERE existing_component_id = #{existingComponentId} ORDER BY config_file_name, config_name

SELECT * FROM t_ddh_configuration_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND ( config_status IN ('NOT_SYNCED', 'OUT_OF_SYNC', 'CONFLICT') OR sync_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (current_value != platform_value AND platform_value IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY importance_level DESC, service_name, config_file_name
SELECT * FROM t_ddh_configuration_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND config_status = 'CONFLICT' ORDER BY service_name, config_file_name
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ddh_configuration_management SET config_status = #{configStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_ddh_configuration_management SET sync_status = #{syncStatus}, last_sync_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT config_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(CASE WHEN importance_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) AS critical_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN importance_level = 'IMPORTANT' THEN 1 END) AS important_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN importance_level = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 END) AS normal_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN importance_level = 'LOW' THEN 1 END) AS low_count FROM t_ddh_configuration_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} GROUP BY config_status

SELECT sync_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(CASE WHEN config_status = 'CONFLICT' THEN 1 END) AS conflict_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN current_value != platform_value AND platform_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS value_mismatch_count FROM t_ddh_configuration_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} GROUP BY sync_status

SELECT validation_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(CASE WHEN importance_level = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 END) AS critical_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN importance_level = 'IMPORTANT' THEN 1 END) AS important_count FROM t_ddh_configuration_management WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND validation_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY validation_status
